question: When the MUTCD requires an implementation decision, who must make that decision and what decision basis must be used?
model_answer: Direct Answer: When an MUTCD provision requires a decision for implementation, that decision must be made by an engineer, or by an individual working under the supervision of an engineer, who has the appropriate experience and expertise for traffic control device decisions. The decision must be based on engineering judgment or an engineering study, as the specific MUTCD provision requires. Supporting text clarifies that the final decision to implement the engineer's solution rests with the agency having jurisdiction over the roadway, after consultation with and based on the engineer's advice. Standards (mandatory): - "Where the content of this Manual requires a decision for implementation, such decisions shall be made by an engineer, or an individual under the supervision of an engineer, who has the appropriate levels of experience and expertise to make the traffic control device decision. Those decisions shall be made using engineering judgment or engineering study, as required by the MUTCD provision." Support (informational context): - MUTCD principles are developed for and used by individuals who are duly authorized and qualified to conduct traffic control device activities. - The MUTCD presumes the user has sufficient working knowledge, professional training and experience, and education in traffic engineering principles. - The MUTCD does not mandate that an engineer make the final decision to implement or execute the engineering-based solution in the field; the engineer (or individual under an engineer's supervision, or other individual duly authorized by State law) develops the solution with specifications for selection and placement of devices, but responsibility for the final implementation decision rests with the agency having jurisdiction over the roadway, after consultation with and based on advice from the engineer. Visual evidence: [Image 8] shows the full page containing Section 1A.04 (Use of the MUTCD), including the Standard paragraph requiring implementation decisions to be made by an engineer or a supervised individual using engineering judgment or engineering study. Citations: - Section 1A.04 Standard §2 (p.2) - Section 1A.04 Support §1 (p.2) - Section 1A.01 Support §6 (p.1) - Section 1D.03 Support §4 (p.32) - Page 43
gold_answer: The decision must be made by an engineer, or by an individual under the supervision of an engineer, who has the appropriate experience and expertise. The decision must use engineering judgment or an engineering study as required by the applicable MUTCD provision.
